claims: Four relevant developmental modules passed 119 focused tests after the multi-probe scoring and projection changes.
Partial fixture correctness is measured separately from all-or-nothing exact-suite correctness; this is not a real-model result or general learning claim.
details: Probe-suite scores now preserve the exact number of correct answers in each bounded suite, with signed A/B history deltas and restoration count delta. The old boolean task correctness remains for compatibility. A partial A result (2/4 correct) now remains distinguishable from no difference (0/4), and all metrics survive the bounded World-State→authorized developmental-history→later-tick cognition path. No same-tick or current-truth promotion is added.
